base: Working v18 archive, saved version 16; user reported that the installer works.
changes: Reuse the prepared original CIA export for reconstruction instead of a second extraction.
Release owned encrypted copies and ROMFS/NCCH intermediates between successful stages.
Replace the staged ROMFS tree during readback with a complete exact-path/SHA-256 snapshot.
Release per-movie mix/track WAVs after successful full decoding while retaining logs and movie checkpoints.
Hard-link generated voices/movies where supported; verify fallback copies.
Release PC exports after verified mod assembly and retain only the chosen final output after full verification.
Preserve metadata reports and support compact-build completion-data summaries.
Add Open finished output, enabled only after successful completion and output-path validation.
Allow advanced scripts to retain intermediates with KeepIntermediate.

python_tests.skip_reason: Optional independent gameplay audio decoder was not supplied.

syntax_parser.note: Tree-sitter is a syntax check, not execution by Windows PowerShell 5.1.

cleanup_tests: Byte-identical finished output; corrupt/incomplete successors block cleanup; external linked paths rejected before deletion; cross-filesystem copy fallback checked.
storage_measurement_note: Removed logical file bytes are reported; hard links do not imply equal physical free-space recovery. No exact real-game peak-storage reduction is claimed.
